plan.description: A clear system for entry, exit, and position sizing outperforms emotional trading over time.

dialog.title: Choose how you want to begin
dialog.description: You can enter with prefilled demo data to explore the dashboard, trades, and analytics right away, or start with an empty workspace and build your own trading journal from scratch. Both options include a short guided tour right after selection.

demo.title: Start with demo data
demo.description: Preload one account, one strategy, and a sample set of trades so the dashboard feels alive immediately.

empty.title: Start with an empty workspace
empty.description: Begin with a clean app if you prefer to add accounts, trades, and strategies in your own way.

intro.title: Welcome to JTrader
intro.description: Here is a quick introduction to get you oriented. {{modeDescription}}
intro.mode_demo: You are entering with demo data, so feel free to click through each area and see how everything works.
intro.mode_empty: This workspace is empty, so the tour will focus on the most important places to begin.

sidebar.title: Navigation sidebar
sidebar.description: All primary areas of the app live here: dashboard, trading, analytics, graph, and settings.

header.title: Quick actions area
header.description: You can switch theme, change language, and open the account menu without leaving the current page.

dashboard_header.title: Today at a glance
dashboard_header.description: This top section helps you understand your current trading state and what to focus on next.

account_selector.title: Filter by account
account_selector.description: When you manage multiple accounts, this control narrows the dashboard and analytics to the account you want to inspect.

dashboard_hero.title: Primary insight area
dashboard_hero.description: If you chose demo data, this area is already filled with metrics and heatmaps. In an empty workspace, this is where your own data will grow over time.

app_content.title: Main workspace
app_content.description: This is where dashboards, trades, and analytics screens appear. Filling this area with your own trading data is the main goal after onboarding.

complete.title: You are ready
complete.demo: Try opening the dashboard and trade list to explore the sample data before adding real trades.
complete.empty: Try creating your first account or importing trades so the dashboard becomes truly yours.
